caption:
A QR code is just a link in disguise. 🔒

1. Look at the link preview before opening
2. Check the domain spelling
3. Never enter passwords or card details from a random code

scenes.text: A QR code is just a link you can't read.
scenes.sub: Read it before you open it.
scenes.say: A QR code is just a link you can't read. Read it before you open it.

scenes.fact: Anyone can print one, or stick one over another.
scenes.say: Myth. QR codes are always safe. Fact. Anyone can print one, or stick a new one over the real one.

scenes.title: Before you open it
items: Be wary of login or payment pages
scenes.say: Three checks. Read the link preview your phone shows. Check the website name is spelled right. Be wary if it asks you to log in or pay.

scenes.title: A code stuck over another
scenes.body: If a code looks pasted on top of a sign, don't scan it.
scenes.say: Red flag. If a code looks stuck on top of another sign, don't scan it.

scenes.label: Go to the official website yourself instead
scenes.say: The safer way is to type the official website yourself instead.
